⭐ **The fence was verified on `origin/main`, ⛔ not assumed from the merge:** `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:1976` still reads `ZAxis type="number" range={[60, 400]}`, byte-identical to its pre-merge text (only the line number moved, 1913 → 1976). objectui#9790 did **not** touch this defect in passing, so this card is takeable exactly as written.

## ⛔ The fork is RULED — direction **DELETE**, and it is ruled by the floor, ⛔ not by preference

The card states plainly that 「whether the repair is to delete the declaration or to give it a `dataKey` … is a product question this card does not answer」, and triage did not answer it either. This seat rules it, and the reasoning is recorded so it can be overturned on sight:

| arm | judgement |
|:--|:--|
| **give it a `dataKey`** | ⛔ **NOT AVAILABLE to this seat or to a dev.** Variable-area marks do not exist in this product today — every mark is painted at recharts' implicit default. Wiring it **adds a capability**, which is 功能新增 and squarely on the 人工地板. ⛔ Only the maintainer can take this arm |
| **delete the inert declaration** | ✅ Executable. The prop is **inert** — that is the card's measured finding, not an assumption — so removing it is **behaviour-neutral**. No authoring surface is touched: the card is explicit that 「no author-supplied value is ignored, because no author supplies one」 |

⇒ exactly one arm is executable at all, so this is ⛔ not a product choice being made on the maintainer's behalf. The standing principles point the same way and are cited rather than invented: ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; 创业阶段不扩散(无拉动的声明面按 implementation-first 处置,已发布零消费的能力不因沉没成本获得豁免); and the basic adjudication principle that 声明而未兑现是实现缺口,补实现或退役. ⚠️ Pull is **measured at zero** — the card records that whether any authored chart expects variable-area marks was NOT measured, and no author can supply the value in the first place.

⭐ **Flagged upward in the round report:** if variable-area scatter marks are wanted, that is a **feature card** with its own appetite, ⛔ not this repair. Deleting the dead declaration does not foreclose it — it removes a promise the tree does not keep.

## ⚠️ The one thing deleting this could break, and it must be checked BEFORE the delete

PR objectui#9680's edge-padding margin is sized to `sqrt(400 / PI)` — **the declared envelope's upper bound, deliberately**, so the margin already survives the day the declaration is made live. ⇒ removing the declaration does not move any rendered pixel, **but it may orphan the PROSE that explains why the margin is that size**, which would leave a docblock deriving a number from a declaration that no longer exists.

⇒ the dev repairs that prose in the same change. ⛔ Leaving a justification pointing at a deleted declaration is the exact drift class this lane keeps filing.

## ⭐ The lesson triage put on this card, carried into the dispatch

「**一条声明不是一条读数。** 分诊席在定级评论里可以引用声明,⛔ 但不得**从声明推出行为预测**而不标明它未测 —— 惰性的声明和生效的声明,在源码里长得一模一样。」

That is on the card because **the triage seat itself was the victim**: objectui#7396's triage comment `5548586258` read this declaration and derived a bubble-size prediction from it, every clause of which is false at this head. ⇒ this card's real value is the class, not the two-character delete.
